name: EPIC 246290412

text.card: A red giant 3,058 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.84 solar masses and 14.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,497 K at its surface.
